scope: Direct music stream files only; no GameCube/Wii image or ROM extraction.
decoder: Existing statically linked vgmstream through StreamBackend.

tests.bounded_render: 8192 frames per file; finite mix samples; each backend sought to 250ms and rendered again
tests.initial_silence: 5 BRSTM files were silent in first 170ms; accepted because short cues may contain intentional leading silence
tests.folder_playlist: Selected stream file remains eligible for same-folder playlist; tested by the stream smoke runner
tests.remote_waveform_spacing: 0.5x minimum; whole 1x steps through32x; common value plus independent per-file/per-track/per-channel overrides; override reset inherits common value; persists across application launches
tests.repeat_playback: Repeat is an independent toggle. When on, the shared producer loops at the decoded boundary. When off, playback ends normally; a loaded track keeps an enabled Play button that restarts it.

owned_stream_inventory.one_lane_meaning: Mono or stereo mix output; no independently decodable track grouping in the file metadata/output
owned_stream_inventory.lane_meaning: Independent decoded PCM track groups, not instrument identity or original synthesizer voices

repeat_boundary_validation.repeat_state: playing=true and no decoder error at each boundary; playback clock wraps to source position
repeat_boundary_validation.audio: SDL dummy output; no physical listening test

repeat_and_play_button_are_separate.repeat_on: Playback remains active while the source position wraps at the track boundary.
repeat_and_play_button_are_separate.repeat_off: Playing becomes false at EOF; a loaded file keeps the Play control enabled.
repeat_and_play_button_are_separate.manual_restart: On a real local Wii BRSTM, clicking Play after EOF restarted at the beginning; PASS.

three_ds_stereo_lane_behavior.BCSTM_BCWAV: If there is one decoded two-channel stream and no distinct groups, display LEFT and RIGHT. Keep explicit decoder track groups when present.
three_ds_stereo_lane_behavior.fixture: channels.bcstm and channels.bcwav verified independent sides and stereo mix reconstruction; stems.bcstm retains its three decoder groups.
three_ds_stereo_lane_behavior.meaning: Stereo sides, not recovered instruments or stems.

limits: This verifies only the formats/files in the supplied folder, not every GameCube or Wii title or codec.
No game disc/ROM extraction, archive browsing, encryption/key handling, or soundtrack discovery is implemented.
No original audio, ROM, or disc image is packaged.
The left/right fallback applies only when the BCSTM/BCWAV decoder reports exactly one two-channel stream. Mono files and explicit track groups keep their decoded layout.
Repeat and Play control state are separate: repeat-on loops; repeat-off reaches EOF and Play stays available. Dummy-audio tests do not prove gapless sound on a physical output device.
